To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) the perplexity of the training data is a poor objective function for language generation, and (2) the objective for language generation can be improved through the use of discriminative models.

(i) a generative RNN language model can be substantially improved by combining multiple discriminatively trained models, and (ii) a decoding objective that is more expressive than perplexity is essential to generate high-quality natural language.

we introduce a general framework for improving the objective for text generation that can be used to address various issues with RNN generation, and that our framework can improve the quality of text generation in multiple ways.
